title: DriverDocumentExpiring v1 payload
description: Published by driver once per accepted document and reminder threshold (7 days, then 1 day) when the document currently in force for its type (and vehicle) is about to end (REQ-DRV-05). Aggregate Driver. Notification turns it into a push to the driver. days_left is counted in the market's time zone: the document is still valid on valid_to and the driver is taken off the line the day after.

valid_to.description: Last day the document is valid.

days_left.description: Days from the run's date to valid_to: 2…7 for the first reminder (7 if the run did not miss a day), 0…1 for the second.
